description: Get current METAR for one or more airports as fully decoded JSON — wind (direction/speed/gust as separate fields), visibility (in SM and meters), sky conditions (cloud coverage + altitude as objects), temperature/dewpoint (°C and °F), altimeter (inHg and hPa), flight category (VFR/MVFR/IFR/LIFR). Saves agents from parsing raw METAR text.

icao_codes.description: Comma-separated ICAO airport codes (uppercase 4 letters). Max 25 per call. Examples: 'KJFK,EGLL,RJTT', 'KSFO', 'EDDF'.

name: checkwx.metar.decoded

error.description: Present only when the call failed. Includes error code, message, request_id, and any provider-specific extras.

result.description: Tool response payload. Shape varies per tool — consult the tool description and inputSchema. May be an object, array, string, or number depending on the upstream provider response.

title: CheckWX Decoded METAR
